semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Single-cell multi-omics is a specific instance of multi-omics. 'Multi-omics' refers to the integrated study of multiple omic data sets, while 'single-cell multi-omics' specifically targets individual cells.

parent_domains.justification: Single-cell sequencing is a method that can be part of multi-omics approaches, particularly those focusing on individual cell analysis across different omic layers.
Bulk sequencing can be seen as a more general genomics approach that underpins broader aspects of omics research, including multi-omics.

closest_parent_domain.justification: Single-cell sequencing directly relates to multi-omics approaches that focus at the cellular level, offering a closer connection than the more generalized bulk sequencing.

closest_child_domain.justification: There are no specific subfields or narrower domains in the given list directly under multi-omics apart from single-cell multi-omics.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Since there are no other comparable counterparts to multi-omics except single-cell multi-omics in the list, identifying a sibling domain is not relevant.
